title: The Quiet Signal Anew
author: Lior Villalobos
blurb: Mara Pemberton, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
